messages:
Nina (People Ops): quick pulse: we need to confirm final reviewer assignments and contingency plans for next week's calibration. please respond if you need a swap.
Omar (Eng Manager): I need to swap Tues 09:00 slot 1: I'll be in customer meetings. anyone take it?
Sofia (Manager): I can swap into Tue 09:00 if it's remote-only. I have a conflicting meeting otherwise.
Nina (People Ops): confirmed Sofia -> I've updated the calendar and the public slot doc. reminder: timebox is 4 min per case.
Omar (Eng Manager): thanks. also, FYI one of my reports has a large doc (20MB) for evidence, upload failing. whats the fallback?
forms-bot: Forms note: if upload fails, email people-ops@redwood with subject "REVIEW-EVIDENCE + employee name"; include manager note.
Sofia (Manager): got it. one more: are new managers required to attend the rubric walkthrough?
Nina (People Ops): walkthrough is optional but recommended; recording and slides will be posted.
Omar (Eng Manager): all good. thanks team.
